verdict.rationale: Codex supports running multiple parallel cloud tasks (codex-docs-1/3/6), browsing active/completed chats and resuming sessions from the CLI/desktop app (codex-docs-15/24/34), a desktop app showing all prior project threads/sessions in a sidebar (codex-comm-18), and delegation to specialized sub-agents brought back into a main session (codex-docs-13/32) — together giving an engineering lead a unified way to manage multiple concurrent agent sessions across cloud/CLI/app surfaces. Missing for 10: independent verification of true multi-user/team-wide session management (RBAC evidence is API/org-level, not session-workspace specific), and some community feedback notes UX paper-cuts and quota/rate limits affecting parallel usage (codex-comm-7, codex-comm-8).
